known_issues.summary: Course-announcement notification fan-out is synchronous and unbounded; request time scales with enrollment (can time out on large courses). Should be a queued, chunked job.
Public Events listing has an N+1 speaker lookup (~12-24 extra queries/page).
First certificate-PDF download renders Chromium synchronously in-request; should pre-generate on CertificateIssued.
Lighthouse Performance 72 (mobile throttled); deficit is entirely LCP due to client-rendered shell. No representative production run captured.
CSP uses script-src 'unsafe-inline' in production (Next inline runtime); nonce-based CSP is optional future hardening.
.trivyignore carries a picomatch exception (CVE-2026-33671) for Next's vendored copy; upstream fix >=4.0.4 exists.
